    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Board
    Represents the physical layout of the game, managing the various card rows, the offering track, and the turn order tile.
    BoardController
    Main controller for the game board screen.
    BuildingCard
    Building Card: unlike characters, it has a food cost (reduced by the player's discounts) and provides aura and/or effects that trigger in different phases (purchase, turn end, event, game end).
    BuildingDoubleInventor
    Building effect: rewards with bonus food the completion of a pair of inventors of the same level.
    BuildingEndgameAura
    Building effect: credits a fixed aura bonus during the endgame scoring.
    BuildingEventCostModifier
     
    BuildingExtraPick
    Building effect: grants the player an extra pick at the end of the turn.
    BuildingImmediateResource
    Building effect: provides aura and/or magic points immediately upon purchase.
    BuildingJobAuraBonus
     
    BuildingShamanPassive
     
    BuildingSixDifferentAura
     
    BuildingSixOfType
    Building effect: grants bonus food every time the player completes a set with at least one character for each of the six jobs.
    BuildingTurnOrderBonus
     
    Card
    Base class of all game cards (Characters, Events, Buildings).
    CardPickedUpdate
     
    CharacterCard
    Character Card: belongs to one of the jobs (JobType) and, once picked, permanently enters the player's tribe, applying its immediate effect and notifying owned buildings.
    CharacterConstructor
    Constructor's effect: upon purchase, increases the player's permanent discount on buildings by a value equal to the card's level.
    CharacterHunter
    Hunter's effect: upon purchase, provides food equal to the number of hunters already owned by the player (including the one just picked).
    CharacterPassive
    "Passive" effect shared by Artist, Inventor, and Gatherer: they produce nothing upon purchase, they only count as statistics for endgame scoring and events.
    CharacterShaman
    Shaman's effect: upon purchase, provides magic points equal to the card's level.
    ChooseTotemRequest
    Request sent by the Client to choose the color of their Totem.
    CLIAbstract
    Interface defining the rendering methods for the Command Line Interface (CLI).
    CLIApp
     
    Client
    Central hub of the Client side.
    ClientConnection
    ============================================================================ ClientConnection — Abstraction of the server -> client communication channel ============================================================================ ROLE: Interface that abstracts the network transport (TCP Socket or RMI).
    ClientMessage
    Root interface for ALL messages traveling on the network.
    ClientModel
    ============================================================================ ClientModel — Lightweight client-side model ============================================================================ ROLE: Maintain a local game state synchronized with the server.
    ClientStateHandler
    Defines the UI behavior and interaction rules for a specific game state.
    ClientStateRegistry
    Registry for all client state handlers.
    Controller
    Core server-side controller managing a single game instance.
    DashboardManager
    Manager responsible for updating and rendering the player's personal dashboard and the opponents' views in the GUI.
    DatabaseConfig
    Configuration for the MySQL database, read from a .env file in the working directory (gitignored — secrets stay local).
    DatabaseManager
    Manages the PostgreSQL database connection (Aiven cloud) and all database operations for persisting match results and querying the leaderboard.
    Deck<T>
    Generic deck of cards (LIFO), based on a Stack.
    DeckFactory
    Game decks factory.
    EndGameState
     
    EndGameUpdate
     
    EndTurnRequest
    Request sent by the Client to voluntarily end the turn.
    ErrorMessageUpdate
    Message sent by the Server to the Client to report an error (e.g., invalid move or wrong parameters).
    EventArtist
    Cave Paintings event effect: those who reach the artists threshold gain proportional aura, those who do not reach it suffer a penalty.
    EventCard
    Event Card: it is resolved globally on all players during the end-of-round events phase.
    EventFarmer
    Sustenance event effect: each player must "feed" their tribe by paying 1 food per card, discounted by gatherers (and buildings); if the food is not enough, they pay the difference in aura.
    EventHunter
    Hunting event effect: rewards each player based on the number of hunters in their tribe, taking into account any temporary modifiers set by buildings.
    EventReport
     
    EventShaman
    Shamanic Ritual event effect: rewards in aura the one with the most magic points and penalizes the one with the least, respecting the shields/doublings set by buildings.
    EventState
     
    EventSummaryManager
    Manager responsible for building and displaying the event summary overlay, detailing the resource changes for each player after an event resolution.
    EventUpdate
     
    EventUpdate.PlayerSnapshot
     
    Game
    Core orchestrator of the game logic.
    GameResumedUpdate
    Broadcast notification to all clients that the game has resumed after a second player has reconnected.
    GameState
    Abstract class representing the game state.
    GameSuspendedUpdate
    Broadcast notification to all clients that the game has been suspended because only one active player is left.
    GetLeaderboardRequest
    Sent from a client to the server to request the full leaderboard for matches with a specific number of players.
    GUIApp
    Main application class for the JavaFX GUI client.
    IDrawable
     
    IEffect<T>
     
    IGame
     
    IGameObserver
     
    JobType
     
    JoinGameRequest
    JoinGameRequest — First contact of the client with the server
    Launcher
    Entry point class for the GUI application.
    Launcher
     
    LeaderboardController
    Controller for the leaderboard scene.
    LeaderboardEntry
    A single entry in the leaderboard.
    LeaderboardUpdate
    Sent from the server to a client to deliver the leaderboard data.
    LobbyController
    Controller for the lobby scene.
    LoginController
    Controller for the initial login scene.
    Main
    Small console demo of the game engine alone (no network): creates a game, joins four players, chooses colors and performs the setup.
    MainClient
    Starts the client in textual mode (CLI).
    MainLauncher
    Main class of the client JAR.
    MarketManager
    Manager responsible for rendering and updating the market cards (characters, buildings, and events) and their respective decks on the GUI board.
    MusicManager
    Manages background audio playback (MP3) using JavaFX MediaPlayer.
    OfferingTile
     
    PersistenceManager
    Manages the JSON file backup of the game for server crash recovery.
    Phases
     
    PickCardRequest
    Request sent by the Client to pick a card. 100% safe: the server will deduce the sender from the associated Socket.
    PickingState
     
    PingRequest
    Heartbeat sent by the Server to the Client to verify the active connection.
    PlaceTotemRequest
    Request sent by the Client to place its own Totem on an offering. 100% safe: the server will deduce the sender from the associated Socket.
    Player
    Represents a participant in the game.
    PlayerDelta
     
    PlayerDisconnectedUpdate
    Broadcast notification to all clients that a player has been marked as disconnected.
    PlayerJoinedUpdate
     
    PlayerReconnectedUpdate
    Broadcast notification to all clients that a player has reconnected.
    PongResponse
    Client's response to the Server's PingRequest.
    Request
    Request sent by the player to the server (CLIENT -> SERVER).
    RMIClientHandler
    ============================================================================ RMIClientHandler — Handler for an RMI connection for a client ============================================================================ ROLE: - Handles RMI requests from a client - Forwards requests to the Controller (single game) - Implements ClientConnection (sendUpdate via RMI callback) - Manages heartbeat (ping/pong) ============================================================================
    RMIClientHandlerInterface
     
    RMIClientInterface

    RMIServerImpl
     
    Server
    ============================================================================ Server — AM54 server entry point (single game) ============================================================================
    ServerConnection
    Generic interface for connection to the Server.
    ServerHandler
    ============================================================================ ServerHandler — Client-side asynchronous listening thread (TCP Socket) ============================================================================ ROLE: Independent thread continuously listening for incoming messages from the server on the TCP Socket connection.
    SetupGameRequest
    Request sent by the Client to signal they are ready for Setup.
    SetUpGameState
     
    SocketClientHandler
    ============================================================================ SocketClientHandler — Handler for a TCP connection for a client ============================================================================ ROLE: - Separate thread for each client connected via TCP Socket - Reads Requests from the client and forwards them to the Controller (single game) - Implements ClientConnection (sendUpdate) and ClientHandler - Manages the heartbeat system (ping/pong) to detect disconnections PING-PONG PATTERN: - Ping every 5 seconds (PING_INTERVAL_MS) - If no Pong is received within 15 seconds (PING_TIMEOUT_MS): 1.
    SocketServerConnection
